mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO, EMAIL, PASSWORD, NICKNAME, NAME, PHONE, INTRO, PROFILE_IMAGE, MEMBER_TYPE, STATUS, EMAIL_VERIFIED, VERIFIED_REVIEWER FROM MEMBER WHERE EMAIL = #{memberEmail} AND STATUS = 'A'

SELECT M.MEMBER_NO, M.EMAIL, M.NICKNAME, M.NAME, M.PHONE, M.GENDER, M.AGE_RANGE, M.PROFILE_IMAGE, M.INTRO, M.MEMBER_TYPE, M.STATUS, M.EMAIL_VERIFIED, M.VERIFIED_REVIEWER, M.CREATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B WHERE B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO AND B.STATUS = 'A') AS POST_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMPANION_REVIEW R WHERE R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO AND R.STATUS = 'Y') AS REVIEW_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMPANION_JOIN J WHERE J.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO AND J.STATUS IN ('W', 'A')) AS COMPANION_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE BL WHERE BL.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) AS LIKE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACCOMMODATION_REVIEW AR WHERE AR.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO AND AR.STATUS = 'A') AS ACCOMM_REVIEW_COUNT FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE EMAIL = #{memberEmail} AND STATUS != 'W'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_NO, EMAIL, PASSWORD, NICKNAME, NAME, PHONE, GENDER, AGE_RANGE, PROFILE_IMAGE, BIRTH_DATE, MEMBER_TYPE, STATUS, EMAIL_VERIFIED, LOGIN_TYPE ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBER_NO.NEXTVAL, #{memberEmail}, #{memberPw}, #{memberNickname}, #{memberName}, #{memberPhone}, #{memberGender}, #{memberAgeGroup}, #{memberProfileImg}, TO_DATE(#{memberBirthDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'U', 'A', 'Y', #{loginType} )
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET NICKNAME = #{memberNickname}, PHONE = #{memberPhone}, PROFILE_IMAGE = #{memberProfileImg}, INTRO = #{memberIntro}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
UPDATE MEMBER SET STATUS = 'W', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.select: SELECT EMAIL, CREATED_AT FROM MEMBER WHERE NAME = #{memberName} AND EMAIL = #{memberEmail} AND STATUS = 'A'
SELECT MEMBER_NO, EMAIL, NAME FROM MEMBER WHERE EMAIL = #{memberEmail} AND NAME = #{memberName} AND STATUS = 'A'
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET PASSWORD = #{memberPw}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE EMAIL = #{memberEmail}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS "boardNo", B.TITLE AS "title", TO_CHAR(B.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "createdAt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENT_TBL C WHERE C.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO AND C.STATUS = 'A') AS "commentCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE BL WHERE BL.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO) AS "likeCount", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY B.CREATED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM BOARD B WHERE B.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND B.STATUS = 'A' ) WHERE RN <= 10

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.REVIEW_NO AS "reviewNo", R.TITLE AS "title", R.RATING AS "rating", TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "createdAt", CB.TITLE AS "companionTitle", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM COMPANION_REVIEW R LEFT JOIN COMPANION_BOARD CB ON R.COMPANION_NO = CB.COMPANION_NO WHERE R.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND R.STATUS = 'Y' ) WHERE RN <= 10

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS "boardNo", B.TITLE AS "title", TO_CHAR(B.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "createdAt", M.NICKNAME AS "authorNickname", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY BL.CREATED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM BOARD_LIKE BL JOIN BOARD B ON BL.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE BL.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND B.STATUS = 'A' ) WHERE RN <= 10
